description: This is a Java source file for an Android InputMethodService implementation named AutofillImeService. It handles inline suggestions, view inflation, and input method lifecycle management for an Autofill keyboard app.

classes.name: AutofillImeService
classes.description: The main class extending InputMethodService, managing inline suggestions and IME lifecycle for Autofill keyboard.

classes.name: SuggestionItem
classes.description: Inner class representing a suggestion view and its pinned status.

classes.name: ResponseState
classes.description: Enum representing different states of response handling within the service.

methods.name: onCreateInputView
methods.description: Creates and initializes the custom input view including keyboard and suggestion UI components.

methods.name: onStartInput
methods.description: Handles input start event, resets decoder, and manages response state.

methods.name: postPendingResponse
methods.description: Schedules handling of an inline suggestions response.

methods.name: cancelDelayedDeletion
methods.description: Cancels scheduled deletion of suggestions if any.

methods.name: scheduleDelayedDeletion
methods.description: Schedules a delayed task to clear suggestions UI.

methods.name: clearInlineSuggestionStrip
methods.description: Clears suggestion views from the UI.

methods.name: onStartInputView
methods.description: Handles UI setup when input view is started.

methods.name: onFinishInputView
methods.description: Handles cleanup when input view is finished or hidden.

methods.name: onComputeInsets
methods.description: Customizes insets for the input view.

methods.name: onCreateInlineSuggestionsRequest
methods.description: Creates a request for inline suggestions with specific styling and size parameters.

methods.name: toPixel
methods.description: Converts DP units to pixels based on display metrics.

methods.name: getHeight
methods.description: Returns height dimension for inline presentation.

methods.name: onInlineSuggestionsResponse
methods.description: Handles inline suggestions from the framework and updates the UI accordingly.

methods.name: updateInlineSuggestionStrip
methods.description: Updates the suggestion view strip with new suggestions.

methods.name: rescheduleShowcaseBgFgTransitions
methods.description: Reschedules background/foreground transition animations for suggestions.

methods.name: rescheduleShowcaseUpDownTransitions
methods.description: Reschedules up/down movement animations for suggestions.

methods.name: inflateThenShowSuggestions
methods.description: Inflates suggestion views asynchronously and updates UI after all are inflated.

methods.name: handle
methods.description: Handles a string command, passing it to the decoder for processing.
